synthetic_sidecar.fair_aligner_metric: coupling / assignment recovery of planted pi*, not ||C-C_true||
synthetic_sidecar.notes: Identity is Bayes-optimal for ||C - C_true|| when C = C_true + E, so reconstruction error to noisy connectomes is not a fair alignment SOTA metric. Coupling recovery (assignment of planted correspondence) is.

verdict.claim_text: Posterior-gated hierarchical alignment improves scan-rescan reliability on real ds000243 vs noalign, BrainSync, and FUGW (paired bootstrap 95% CIs exclude 0 for all three). Identification is NOT claimed: the same-map ident metric is invariant to any per-subject invertible map (fitted/permuted/Haar-random maps all score 83/83).
do_not_claim: ID superiority if bootstrap CI includes 0
Gain-null nonident counts as scientific rate
Identification superiority under per-subject-map protocols (map-invariant artifact — Haar-random control = 83/83)
notes: Identification is NOT claimable under per-subject same-map protocols: the metric is invariant to the map (fitted, permuted and Haar-random per-subject maps all give 1.0; identity 0.9157; single common map 0.9036). Use a leak-free (cross-fitted) protocol to assess identification.
CORRECTED 2026-09-20: ident claim withdrawn — same-map identification is map-invariant (Haar/permuted controls both 1.0); reliability claim unaffected. See RESULTS.md and PLAN.md §4b.

literature_motivation.Thual_2025_TMLR: our approach currently requires left-out participants to watch the same stimuli as reference participants. It is yet unclear whether functional alignment could bring improvements without this constraint.
literature_motivation.BrainSync_Joshi_2018: the BrainSync transform will always attempt to maximize correlations, resulting in some degree of positive correlation even for data that do not satisfy our underlying assumption of common networks.
literature_motivation.Takeda_2025_iScience: In both datasets we analyzed in this study, the results of unsupervised alignment at the individual level were statistically unreliable.
literature_motivation.why_gap_columns_matter: These quotes document that point-estimate rest aligners cannot say whether an individual map is real. tau_phi + group n_eff/REML weights are the missing columns; baselines emit alignment for every subject with no flag.

notes: Statistical verification of REAL N=83 posterior_shrink SOTA. beta=28.438323293411973. conn_srm not treated as a valid gain competitor. Coverage not headlined.
